text: EP.14|Trump Assassin Bombshell, Vance Attacks & MTG CNN Apology w/ Glenn Greenwald | The Megyn KellyEP.14|Trump Assassin Bombshell, Vance Attacks & MTG CNN Apology w/ Glenn Greenwald | The Megyn Kelly Welcome to Boldline Briefings where complex events are broken down with clarity, speed, and sharp analysis. In today’s briefing, we dive into: ➡️ Megyn Kelly is joined by Glenn Greenwald of Rumble’s System Update to discuss Tucker Carlson’s explosive new documentary on attempted Trump assassin Thomas Crooks, revelations about Crooks’ true online activity, and allegations that the FBI is withholding key information. They examine reporting suggesting Crooks was involved in trans and furry online communities, efforts to label Tucker Carlson as antisemitic, and the reality of Tucker’s views on Israel and foreign policy. The discussion also covers attacks on JD Vance from both the left and parts of the right, speculation about a potential Ted Cruz challenge in the 2028 GOP primary, Marjorie Taylor Greene’s break with Trump and her surprising apology on CNN, revelations that a Democratic politician was texting Jeffrey Epstein as late as 2019, and what the latest Epstein disclosures may still uncover.
